name: AgentRun
description: Runs Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode or pi agents with durable execution, spend caps and approvals, and makes them learn notes and skills from each run.

skills.name: Learn From Each Run
skills.description: Keeps notes, skills and learned workflows an agent proposes after a run, checks and grades them, and commits the keepers.

skills.name: Durable Runs
skills.description: Stores every run so it carries on after a server restart, inside a sandbox, Linux desktop, Android phone or browser.

skills.name: Typed Workflows
skills.description: Runs repeatable work as typed workflows of tool calls, model steps and scored decisions, falling back to an agent when unsure.

skills.name: Approvals and Spend Caps
skills.description: Pauses runs for human answers and approvals, caps each run's cost, and shows every agent's runs and spend in one console.

skills.name: Agents as an API
skills.description: Starts and waits on agent runs over HTTP or with the TypeScript and Python clients, using a server token for auth.
